items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Emerson, New Jersey. I’m very pleased to be speaking with Sonny Igoe today for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College.

ctx.x: After service in the Marine Corps, he toured with Les Elgart and Ina Ray Hutton, and was a member of Woody Herman’s Third Herd. Sonny worked in the New York City recording studios during the 1960s and is now a respected percussion teacher.
Sonny was interviewed at his home in Emerson, New Jersey on July 31, 2003 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
